info.title: credfeto-git-mcp
info.description: Credfeto Git MCP server: a fixed set of git operations with validated inputs over stdio MCP

options.name: --self-test
options.description:
Builds the server's tools and finds git on PATH, then exits: 0 when that works, 1 with a
one-line reason on stderr when it does not. Starts no MCP transport, reads no input and runs
no git command except, when GIT_MCP_REPO_ROOT is unset and the default folder is missing,
the one that finds the repository root.
